dependency_policy: Released artifacts pinned by uv.lock; one source-verified TRL loss-hook patch, no vendored trainers.

components.name: PyTorch
components.use: Autograd, PCA, sampling, tensor operations and checkpointed exact control

components.name: Liger-Kernel
components.use: Optimized chunked distillation control; H100 acceptance passed on the locked runtime

components.name: TRL
components.use: Full-distribution on-policy distillation, generation, distributed training, logging and checkpoints

components.name: OPD2
components.use: Public training data and math evaluation protocol; not its policy loss

components.name: Evalchemy
components.use: OPD2 official evaluation image and task adapters

components.name: TA-OPD
components.use: Equation 4 and Appendix D.2 baseline; independent PyTorch implementation checked against the official FSDP loss. Same TRL training protocol as other methods.
